new.title: New Project
new.subtitle: Create a new book, series, or course project

form.title: Project Details
form.description: Fill in the details below to set up your new project. You can always change these later.
form.projectTitleHelp: This can be a working title — you can change it anytime.
form.projectTypeHelp: Choose the type of content you're creating.
form.genreHelp: Primary genre helps AI tailor research and writing assistance.
form.penNameHelp: Leave blank to use your account name. Useful for multiple pen names.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Brief description of your book (what it's about, who it's for, what makes it unique)
form.descriptionHelp: This helps AI understand your project. Not published anywhere.
form.targetAudiencePlaceholder: Describe your ideal reader (e.g., 'beginner entrepreneurs aged 25-40 looking for practical startup advice')
form.targetAudienceHelp: The more specific, the better AI can help with writing tone and marketing.
form.keywordsHelp: Keywords help with market research and Amazon category targeting.
form.targetWordCountHelp: Typical ranges: Short book 15K-30K, Standard 40K-60K, Long 70K-100K+
form.targetDateHelp: Set a deadline to stay on track. We'll remind you as it approaches.
form.marketplaceHelp: Where do you plan to publish? This affects formatting and metadata.
form.seriesHelp: Link this book to a series for read-through tracking.
form.coverImageHelp: Upload a draft cover or placeholder. You can design one in Cover Design Studio later.
form.coverImageDragDrop: Drag and drop an image, or click to browse
form.coverImageFormats: PNG, JPG, or TIFF. Recommended: 2560 x 1600px for ebook.
form.templateHelp: Templates include pre-built outlines and chapter structures.
form.aiContentHelp: KDP requires disclosure of AI-generated content. We'll help you manage this.
